description: Replaces the text of an outreach draft that is waiting for approval. The current draft and the lead's scoreExplanation come from list_pending_outreach; get_lead_memo carries the richer research on that person. The rewritten draft stays in the approval queue, and this tool sends nothing.

leadId.description: Lead whose draft to rewrite, from list_pending_outreach

subject.description: Email subject; only email delivery reads it, and send_outreach, a LinkedIn send, does not. When omitted, the stored subject stays unchanged, so a body-only edit keeps it; a string replaces it, and null clears it.

text.description: The full replacement message. This same string is called `draftText` when list_pending_outreach returns it, and `confirmText` when you pass it to send_outreach — three names, one set of bytes.

name: rewrite_outreach
title: Rewrite outreach draft
